title: Odd one out
description: A cyan culture journal opens around its spine to reveal the first page.
useCase: Offer a tactile preview of a publication, lookbook or small editorial collection before taking readers into the full content.
reducedMotion: The cover changes to its open or closed pose immediately. Keyboard activation also skips the turn.
limitations: A single rigid cover turn, not a deforming paper simulation or full reader. Native 3D transforms are required for the dimensional presentation.
look: Bright cobalt-blue field with a tilted magazine, shown open: dark teal inside cover of rotated aqua type beside a cream page of heavy black type.
motion: Pressing the toggle swings the cover open around its left spine from −12° to −152° over 640 ms with a strong ease-out; closing reverses from its current angle.
adapt: `turn` animates `transform` with `element.animate` from the computed pose to `rotateY(-152deg)` or `rotateY(-12deg)` (640 ms, `cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.2,1)`); `sf-issue-front` and `sf-issue-back` are the backface-hidden faces. Replace the cover and page copy.
